description: Broadband Community Anchor Institution Listings is a dataset listed in State of Washington open data portal (data.wa.gov), an open data portal (Socrata) of a region, state, county or agency, published or maintained by State of Washington. Broadband availability at Community Anchor Institutions, as collected by the Washington State Broadband Office for the State Broadband Initiative. Coverage: Washington State. The portal files it under the category Economics. Its tags are broadband, community anchor. The table has 31 columns. Attribution on the portal: Washington State Broadband Office. The portal shows 2015-01-27 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is public domain (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network deployment studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-data-wa-gov-portal.
